unlisted_practices: Conduct use-case-based empirical studies of explainability, including clinician and patient perspectives on its relevance and implications.
Choose the type and amount of explanation to fit the specific tool, application, and use context rather than taking a one-size-fits-all approach to explainability.
Compare the performance of an AI tool with and without post hoc explanation components to determine how explanations affect accuracy.
Draw knowledge-based models on a larger number of clinical experts to avoid idiosyncratic rules, shortcuts, or biases.

screen.reason: This is a conceptual and case-based commentary discussing the ethical, clinical, and practical role of explainability in AI-based clinical decision support systems.
